facts.event: Hadiah 替 Tilde 敷上冷敷布，Marolyn 一边替她梳头一边咒骂 Gundobar、篡位者、傲慢王子与不敢直视她的 tarns。
facts.relation: Marolyn 是 Tilde 的贴身女伴，Hadiah 是她的表姐
facts.anchor: That bastard,’ Marolyn hissed as Hadiah put a cold compress on my elbow.

facts.event: Hadiah 断言 Liran 一死诸子必起战，并逐一点明长子只得 Suneheim、次子 Isen 有黑卫、Cynghal 之军靠劫掠而财源已枯。
facts.relation: Hadiah 是 Tilde 的表姐兼宫廷情报顾问，向 Tilde 分析 Cynghal 三王子
facts.anchor: There would be war,’ she said at last.

facts.event: Hadiah 讲述 Liran 少年时叔父们为夺盐与改宗弑其父，他逃过政变、聚兵回来夺回王冠。
facts.relation: Liran 是被弑君者之子、以复仇起家的王
facts.anchor: Liran’s uncles killed his father for taking the salt and converting to the Wing’s faith

facts.event: 一群女仆抬着大小礼箱、铜浴盆与热水涌进房间，称这些是宫廷贵族送来的 morgengabe。
facts.relation: 女仆与 serf 属于公主/后宫主管 Morwynna 管辖
facts.anchor: These are morgengabe,’ said the servant to Hadiah.

facts.event: Morwynna 自报是后宫女眷居所的主管，并冷然纠正 Marolyn：她是 Cynghal 人，不是 Merogian。
facts.relation: Morwynna 是公主 Elise 手下的后宫主管，与 Merogian 俘虏身份切割
facts.anchor: No,’ she said, her tone cooling. ‘I am Cynghal.

facts.event: 公主 Elise 闯入斥责 Tilde 当众裸浴不知遮掩，随后宣布晚祷后在 Nest 由大祭司为她主婚，并指定用其亡母的婚纱。
facts.relation: Elise 是 Cynghal 公主、被派来监管 Tilde 的婚礼
facts.anchor: There the high priest has agreed to marry you.

facts.event: Tilde 从梁上绳圈与书架上认出这是已故王后 Isabella 的寝殿，那绳是她的生育绳，而 Elise 被命令服侍母亲的替代者。
facts.relation: Isabella 是 Liran 已故王后、Elise 之母；Tilde 是她的替代者
facts.anchor: Elise had been ordered to serve her mother’s replacement

facts.event: Hadiah 坦白早已看穿 Tilde 求死之心并告知其母，随后三人相拥发誓无论痛苦或死亡都与她同担。
facts.relation: Hadiah、Marolyn 是 Tilde 的两位女伴，发誓共赴生死
facts.anchor: I told your mother you intended to die here
